title: Compile parameters
action: Load the provided tables of polarizabilities (α_M++, α_X--), second ionization energies I₂, second electron affinities E₂, lattice constants, Madelung constants A, and homopolar corrections ΔU₁, ΔU₂. For each crystal, compute the nearest-neighbor distance r₀, Madelung energy VM = 2Ae²/r₀, electrostatic term U_el = 2(2A-1)e²/r₀, and classify the structure as rocksalt or zincblende/wurtzite.
description: Gathers and derives all intermediate parameters needed for the absorption energy formulas.

title: Compute absorption energies and write CSV
action: Using the derived intermediate quantities and the provided formulas for polarization, sharing, and homopolar energies (standard formulas for rocksalt, modified for zincblende/wurtzite), compute the first absorption band energy hν₁ and second absorption band energy hν₂, and write them to a CSV file.
description: Compute the first and second absorption band energies for all specified crystals.
output_schema: CSV with columns: crystal (string), hν1_eV (float, eV), hν2_eV (float, eV). One row per crystal.
